verdict.rationale: Convex explicitly documents self-hosting the open-source backend on your own servers, with the same code as the cloud service, and GitHub confirms it works with common infra (Neon, Fly.io, Vercel, RDS, Postgres, etc.). missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of running self-hosted Convex in production and more detail on feature parity/limitations versus the managed cloud offering.
